subject: Your app is about to get even better
preview_text: Here's what's coming next (you heard it here first). Exclusive sneak peek inside.
body_paragraphs: A few months ago, a founder told me she spent 2 hours every Monday just digging through old meeting notes to find a single decision. She said it felt like a tax on her time. I promised her we'd fix that. And now, we're about to release something that does exactly that—turns your entire meeting history into a searchable, instant recall system.

Imagine typing 'budget decision from March' and getting the exact summary, action item, and who said what. No scrolling, no guessing. That's what's landing in your app next week. We've been testing it internally, and it's already saving our own team hours every week. You're one of the first to know because you've been with us from the start.

Here's the feature: Smart Search. It connects to every meeting you've ever recorded in Smart Notes. Just describe what you need, and it pulls the right transcript or summary in seconds. No setup, no extra taps. It works right from the main screen, so you can find what you need before your next meeting even starts.

Open the app today and record one meeting—your brain will thank you when Smart Search launches and instantly finds it. P.S. Premium users will get unlimited search. Your trial already includes it, so you're set.
cta_text: Open Smart Notes - AI Meeting Summary
